description: Persistent semantic memory for Grok Bot — skills and hosted Reqall MCP

REQALL_API_KEY.title: Reqall API key
REQALL_API_KEY.description: Optional fallback Bearer token from your Reqall account or `reqall login`. Prefer native MCP OAuth; set this only when OAuth is unavailable on the host.

REQALL_URL.title: Reqall server URL
REQALL_URL.description: API base URL. Change only if you self-host.
